company_context: Aeon AI is disrupting the real-estate market with a cloud-based platform to help guide large-scale property development decisions through analysis and forecasting for land developers and government entities.
summary_paragraphs: Advanced the MVP into a geospatial data science platform using open-source technologies including Apache Superset, Carto, and Dremio. Partnered with cities, states, and metropolitan planning organizations to model growth and land use. Trained and mentored data science staff. Personally implemented a geospatial extension to Dremio in Java to support 76 industry-standard geometry SQL functions and 21 H3 index functions based on Uber’s Hexagonal Spatial Index. Created a custom Docker build of CartoDB with extended geospatial statistical analysis. Created processes to normalize Census ACS datasets for use in the data analysis platform.
